preconditions.description: Lengths of S and T are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABC' for c in S) and all(c in 'ABC' for c in T)
preconditions.description: Both S and T consist only of the characters 'A', 'B', and 'C'.
Number of queries Q is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= bi <= len(S) and 1 <= ci <= di <= len(T) for ai, bi, ci, di in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query's indices are within the valid range for S and T.

postconditions.description: The output string has the same length as the number of queries.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in output)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: all('1' if is_transformable(S[ai-1:bi], T[ci-1:di]) else '0' for ai, bi, ci, di in queries) == [c for c in output]
postconditions.description: The i-th character in the output string is '1' if it is possible to transform S[ai..bi] into T[ci..di], otherwise '0'.
